title: Aqar.fm Property Scraper
description: Scrape real estate listings from Aqar.fm (Saudi Arabia). Provide a search URL or let the actor use defaults. Supports all property types: apartments, villas, lands, buildings, and more.

startUrl.title: Aqar.fm Search URL
startUrl.description: Paste any Aqar.fm search URL, e.g. https://sa.aqar.fm/en/apartment-for-rent/riyadh or https://sa.aqar.fm/en/villa-for-sale/jeddah. Leave empty to scrape all listings.

results_wanted.title: Maximum results
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of listings to collect.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy for reliable scraping.
